source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Identify and list all parts of the fire-safety system that were checked, for example, fire alarms, sprinklers, extinguishers, emergency lighting, and fire exits.

4. Record the date, time, and location of each inspection clearly.

5. For each failed check, document:
   - The specific item or system that failed.
   - The nature of the failure (e.g., alarm not sounding, sprinkler head clogged, extinguisher out of date, bulb out in emergency lighting, fire exit obstructed).
   - Include observations and any unusual findings that might indicate why a failure occurred.

6. Attach any relevant photos, video evidence, or test results that illustrate or clarify the failure.

7. Record the name(s) and title(s) of who conducted the check(s) and any witnesses present during the inspection.

8. Create a brief summary for each failed check to make the report easier to understand at a glance.
